title: At the clinic — in sentences
summary: Use the English meaning as well as the Swedish context to choose or type the missing word or phrase. Practise the language of appointments and symptoms. Också means too; heller is used with negation for not … either. These are language exercises, not medical instructions.

s01.sentenceGloss: A heart pumps blood. The heart is in the chest.

s02.sentenceGloss: My temperature is high; I have a fever.

s03.sentenceGloss: I am ill and my brother is ill too.

s04.sentenceGloss: I do not smoke, and she does not smoke either.

s05.sentenceGloss: How long have you been in pain?

s06.sentenceGloss: I want to book an appointment with the doctor.
s06.note: Boka en tid: book an appointment.

s07.sentenceGloss: When I get home, I have an appointment to keep.

s08.sentenceGloss: The doctor says: “Take the medicine according to the instructions.”
s08.note: Ta is the imperative of ta.
